children: Sept 24 (Reuters) - Global crude steel production in August fell 1.2% from a year earlier to 144.2 million tonnes, World Steel Association data showed on Thursday.
Crude steel output from China, the world's top producer and consumer of the metal, fell 3.7% to 74.6 million tonnes in August, the data showed.
